propositions: det_floor.py (793 LOC) exceeds the 800-LOC hard cap by only 7 lines and must be split to comply.
The blocking vs never-blocking DET check boundary is a closed call-graph seam: p2/p3/p6/p7 never-blocking checks form an isolated cluster with zero edges to retained checks.

Four module-object bindings (DET_CHECKS, run_det_floor, est_tokens, and internal helpers like _count_ac_items) are monkeypatched by tests and must remain in det_floor.py so patches continue to reach live code.

Moving p2_resolution, p3_package_existence, p6_ac_quality, and p7_destructive to a new det_advisory.py sibling requires that module to declare its own imports for bare-name dependencies (vague_hits_in_line, _lint_verify_command, _verify_command_strings) instead of inheriting them through det_floor.
det_floor.py must re-export all moved symbols to preserve backward compatibility with existing import points and attribute access paths.
